breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed the final SCF to use the original starting structure rather than the vc-relaxed structure. The generated specification correctly states 'run an SCF calculation on the vc-relaxed structure' and 'Report the final total energy from the SCF on the vc-relaxed structure,' which aligns with the ground truth prompt that simply says to run SCF on the relaxed structure without any mention of reverting to the original starting structure.
